entries.zh: 烹死（把作恶者处死；火刑烧死恶人）
entries.en: to boil/roast to death; to burn an evildoer (as execution)
to roast meat
to roast on a grill/gridiron; to broil

entries.zh: 火焙死人（把人像圣洛伦佐一样架火烤死）
entries.en: to roast a person over fire (like St. Lawrence on the gridiron)
entries.notes: 西语缩写 as. lorenço 推断为 a san Lorenzo（烤架殉道的圣洛伦佐典故），且 M 栏一处声调污损 T99。

entries.en: to singe/scorch or prepare (recado: goods, ingredients) by scorching
entries.notes: 西语 recado 在马尼拉语境兼指货物、药材配料，炮制义项据汉字炮与声调推断。

entries.zh: 炮手头（炮铳一类火器；火炮部件/炮械）
entries.en: firearms, cannon pieces (lit. 'cannon-hand-things')
entries.notes: 西语 asar cañones 与四字汉字语义衔接不明，手头一词取器物泛称义，存疑。

entries.zh: 炮烧（炮烙烧灼；用火猛烧）
entries.en: to scorch/burn fiercely (cf. hostiar, to strike/scorch)
entries.notes: 西语 hostar 罕见、义项不确定，据汉字炮烧与闽南对音推断。

entries.zh: 向人讨火来焙（向人乞火烤炙）
entries.en: to beg fire from someone to roast by (asking for a burning coal)

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕（腹胼，或为腹胁/腹部某部位）
entries.en: belly-side/abdomen area (uncertain character)
entries.notes: 西语词头 Asa. 缩写残缺，汉字胼有 [疑:胼/膀] 标记，四栏互证不足。

entries.en: roasted red by fire; glowing red
to burn charcoal red (glowing coals)
entries.notes: 西语词头 acqua 应为 ascua（炭火）之讹，据汉字与闽南对音定释义。

entries.en: glowing coals, embers (ascua)
to stretch, to string (hilo: thread)

entries.zh: 张鬼（张（网）捕捉鬼魅；风暴中驱鬼祟）
entries.en: to snare/ward off demons (penganas) in the tempest
entries.notes: 汉字眉有 [疑:眉/鬼] 标记；据西语 penganas（鬼魅）与 tempestad 定为鬼字义。

entries.en: to stretch and hold taut

entries.zh: 张网（设网张望；张网伺捕）
entries.en: to spread a net; to watch from a net/ambush
to peer at, to spy
entries.notes: 汉字瞷有 [疑:瞷/間] 标记，据闽南对音 kam 与西语 asechar（窥伺）定瞷义。

entries.en: to peep, to spy on
entries.notes: M 栏附多音（tau ban cuã 等），以 R 栏 cuy 官话对音为定。

entries.en: to spy, to catch sight of by peeping
to rush in, to poke in (cautiously)
entries.notes: 西语 Apechar 词形存疑（疑为 apecharse/asomarse 类），据汉字闯与对音 cham 定义。

entries.zh: 闯头看（把头探出窗外看）
entries.en: to stick one's head out of the window to look
to inquire, to find out (by asking around)
entries.notes: 汉字探有 [疑:探/採] 标记，据闽南 tham 与西语 ynformar se 定探听义。
